tasks.short: Notify agencies of deviations from remediation plans.

steps.what: Retrieve actual field deviations and the applicable approved remediation plan
Assess deviation significance, notification requirements and proposed remedial explanation
Prepare the deviation notice with evidence references and required factual fields
Check the complete final notice, attachments and correct agency destination
Submit the checked final notice to the permitting agency

tasks.design: Configure native {PROJECT} deviation views and {DOCS} notice fields before custom work. The planner determines significance, writes the explanation and checks the complete final notice before a separate {GOV_PORTAL} submission.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated plan lookup and factual notice fields.
tasks.enabler_now: Native case links and reusable notice layouts.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding material deviations and appropriate disclosure.
tasks.human_edge: Explain what actually changed and its environmental implications.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated notice preparation; notification judgement unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native project views and document fields can reduce repeated remediation-plan lookup and factual notice preparation.

assumptions: Boundary begins with actual recorded deviations and ends with agency submission. Field supervisor produces date, location, planned measure, observed departure and evidence reference; plan owner supplies version and permit conditions. Planner resolves missing data manually in s1 and decides significance in s2. No automated regulator acceptance or corrective work is implied.

Native first, existing configuration yields no saving. Provisional shares unmeasured; only repeated lookup and factual formatting reduce. Final notice checking15 is ordinary existing work, submission1 fully retained. Any changed notice or destination invalidates the gate; planner has delegated submission authority, otherwise actual authorised sign-off must be counted before action.
unknowns: Actual notification channel and delegated authority
research_questions: Which notice fields can safely link to existing deviation records?

incremental.description: Maintain plan links and notice field mappings

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked complete final notice, attachments and agency destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional lookup20 reduced25 percent saves5 and notice29 reduced25 percent saves7.25, minus0.5 upkeep=11.75. Half eligible notices gives5.625; assessment35, final checking15 and submission1 unchanged.

tasks.short: Write grant applications for restoration funding.

steps.what: Read grant conditions and verify project scope, evidence and cost inputs
Choose the project case, outcomes, delivery plan and defensible budget proposal
Write grant narrative and assemble required technical attachments

loop.purpose: Draft the chosen restoration funding case
loop.input: verified grant pack, call requirements and planner selected proposal
loop.output: draft grant narrative with evidence references and missing fields
loop.check: Planner checks eligibility statements, budget meaning, proposed commitments, outcome claims and omitted call requirements against sources
loop.stop: Missing costs, unsupported outcomes or two failed revisions return composition to planner
loop.why_not_simpler: Native grant headings and fixed fields first; each funding case requires variable evidence-grounded prose

steps.what: Check the complete final application and attachment consistency
Save the checked final application for the authorised funding owner

tasks.design: Test native {DOCS} grant sections and field reuse first, then draft variable narrative from the verified call and planner-selected project case. The planner checks the complete final application; the funding owner's actual organisational commitment and external submission remain separate work without claimed savings here.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated grant composition across different funding requirements.
tasks.still_hard: Credible outcomes, eligibility and a viable funded project.
tasks.human_edge: Choose a restoration case worth funding and defend its delivery assumptions.
tasks.altitude: Less composition time; no new spending or grant-commitment rights.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: source-grounded drafting can restate a selected grant proposal but cannot establish eligibility, project outcomes or organisational funding commitments.

assumptions: Task is writing grants, through final application save, not external submission. Funding-call issuer supplies actual conditions and deadlines; project owner supplies scope, activities and evidence; finance or cost owner supplies dated amount, unit, category and assumptions. Planner verifies inputs in s1, manually resolves gaps and selects the proposal in s2; no free invented budget.

Native first; existing templates earn zero saving. Provisional shares not measured. Ordinary final writing check20 retained, save1 retained. External commitment requires actual funding-owner approval after the full final version exists, outside this writing boundary with no avoided labour claimed.
unknowns: Actual call variety and cost-input completeness
research_questions: Can drafts preserve eligibility limits and distinguish proposed from established outcomes?

already_counted.description: Grant draft meaning checks and corrections

incremental.description: Maintain grant evidence access and evaluate drafting examples

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked complete final grant application and attachments

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional narrative29 reduced40 percent saves11.6 minus1.5 upkeep=10.1; half eligible grant narratives gives4.3. Verification25, proposal choices25, final check20 and save1 unchanged.

tasks.short: Plan and supervise environmental compliance studies.

steps.what: Retrieve facility constraints, regulatory conditions and existing environmental evidence
Choose study questions, methods, coverage and quality criteria
Write and check the actual study protocol and assigned responsibilities
Save the final study protocol
Direct actual study work and resolve technical or compliance issues with staff
outputs: actual supervision decisions and observed results

steps.what: Record actual study supervision findings, decisions and follow-up needs
inputs: actual supervision decisions and observed results

steps.what: Save the actual supervision record

tasks.design: Configure native {DOCS} facility-condition views and study protocol fields. Keep method selection and actual supervision human, and record outcomes only after the work occurs; no completion is inferred from the protocol.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated condition lookup and protocol formatting.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document links and reusable protocol structure.
tasks.still_hard: Study adequacy and unexpected conditions during facility work.
tasks.human_edge: Set appropriate methods and correct the actual study as conditions change.
tasks.altitude: Less preparation repetition; study supervision responsibility unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native condition views and protocol templates reduce repeated preparation while actual study design and supervision remain expert work.

assumptions: Boundary is planner study preparation and own supervision records. Facility owner supplies scope, activity and location; compliance owner supplies current conditions and references. Planner retrieves and resolves missing context in s1, selects questions, coverage, methods and responsibilities in s2, and writes protocol in s3. Staff produce actual study observations during s5; planner captures own supervision results in s6 after execution.

Native first; existing configuration earns zero. Shares provisional and apply to a study involving both planning and supervision; planning-only cases need a different denominator. Only repetitive lookup/layout reduce. Actual directions and outcome entries remain, saves1 each retained; no new note-approval step added.
unknowns: Actual planning-to-supervision mix and native templates
research_questions: Which protocol fields repeat without requiring a new technical choice?

incremental.description: Maintain condition links and protocol fields

approvals.approved_version: s3 complete checked final study protocol
s6 complete checked actual supervision record

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional source15 reduced30 percent saves4.5 plus protocol14 reduced20 percent saves2.8 minus0.5 upkeep=6.8; half eligible preparation gives3.15. Method choice25, supervision35, outcome record9 and two saves1 unchanged.

steps.what: Locate the current remediation design, site evidence and review criteria
Assess design assumptions, site fit, risks and remediation effectiveness
Write and check actual review comments against the design revision
Save the checked review comments on the design record

tasks.design: Configure native {DOCS} design-revision and evidence links for the reviewer. Preserve the actual review and comment writing; a source view does not establish remediation effectiveness.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the right design revision and supporting evidence.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document relationships and review views.
tasks.still_hard: Whether the design addresses real site mechanisms and uncertainty.
tasks.human_edge: Challenge weak remediation assumptions and identify site-specific risks.
tasks.altitude: Less retrieval; technical review authority unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native document revision views can reduce retrieval without automating scientific design review.

assumptions: Boundary is actual design review and its comments through save. Design owner supplies revision, site identifier and linked drawings; site investigator supplies actual evidence references; compliance owner supplies criteria. Planner resolves missing or superseded sources in s1 and writes real review findings in s2/s3; no free extracted checklist or automated effectiveness verdict.

Native first, existing views earn zero. Provisional retrieval15 is actual repeated source lookup within review, not added administration. Comment writing19 remains unchanged because a template already suffices; save1 fully retained. Shares unmeasured.
unknowns: Current revision links and actual retrieval burden
research_questions: Can native views reliably expose the applicable design and evidence revisions?

approvals.approved_version: s3 complete checked final design review comments

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional lookup15 reduced30 percent saves4.5 minus0.5 upkeep=4; half eligible reviews gives1.75. Review65, actual comments19 and save1 unchanged.
